title: I'm on Vacation Fishing Charters
specs: You MUST purchase a freshwater, and a saltwater fishing license.
LA residents recommended to get annual Basic fresh and saltwater license for $2 more.
Non-residents recommended to get 3 day Charter Passenger Freshwater and Saltwater licenses for $30 total.
Louisiana Lifetime Fishing License holders are exempt from purchasing.

services.name: Meet Your Charter Fishing Captain
services.desc: Just a short drive from New Orleans, you’ll quickly leave behind the hustle and noises of the city and find yourself in peaceful bliss at the edge of it all. As you pull in to Shell Beach, you’ll notice the Oyster boats, Shrimp boats, Crab Boats and Fishing Boats and quickly understand why the Louisiana Marsh is special. You’ll step right on the boat and take off through Louisiana’s beautiful coastal marshes, take in the kind of sunrise you’ll never forget, while seeing endless wildlife (like the famous Louisiana Brown Pelican, alligators, dolphins, nutria, seagulls, and more.)
